findings.observation: Camera and projected coordinates are factory closure variables; public API returns screen and bounds update, not a shared transform/inverse hook.
Flat terrain longitude/latitude derives directly from bounds and full-screen UV. An external overlay-only rotation does not rotate the base geography.
Only four geographic bounds are accepted. Minimum-detail admission exists and must be preserved.

outputRenderer permits shared Three rendering/output composition but exposes no public geographic transform/inverse/shader callback. Monkey-patching renderer.render to mutate private cameras or shaders is not a supported protected-preserving adapter.
Existing rotation resamples copied completed native framebuffer; expressly unsuitable for the current MASTER.
Final track key must be closest. Review A must not be forced into this legacy contract using a fake final key.
Runtime selects Area/Flow; native graphic pass disabled and overlay draw is marker-only. General line/metric metadata is not a connected consumer.

requiredChanges: Shared forward/inverse camera transform for actual geographic camera and terrain inverse sampling
Screen projection and inverseScreen public pairing
All-four-rotated-corner source admission preserving existing minimum detail and source checks
Unchanged default path; screen-space glyph/pin orientation preserved
notSufficient: Add a second full map renderer
